title: calendula arvensis subsp. micrantha
intro: Calendula arvensis subsp. micrantha, commonly known as the small-flowered pot marigold, is a subspecies of the calendula arvensis plant, belonging to the daisy family (Asteraceae). It is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, making it useful in wound healing, skin issues, and infections. The therapeutic actions of Calendula arvensis subsp. micrantha include its ability to promote tissue repair, reduce inflammation, and prevent infection, which is attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, triterpenoids, and carotenoids. These constituents contribute to its antioxidant, antiviral, and immunomodulatory activities, supporting the plant's traditional use in herbal medicine for various health concerns.
